instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. In a bright indoor dance studio with white paneled walls, the instructor in a black long-sleeved top (R1) stands behind the young student in a pink tutu (R2). The young student stands in profile facing left with her arms raised high and one leg extended back, smiling happily. The instructor supports the student's waist with her right hand and holds her raised left foot with her left hand, looking down at her leg to guide her posture. Soft, bright natural light illuminates the clean white setting, creating a gentle and focused atmosphere.
